author: Daniele Morais
title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake strikes near San José del Palmar (Colombia)
seoTitle: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake near San José del Palmar
subtitle: The quake was recorded at a depth of 110 km, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).
excerpt: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake was recorded near San José del Palmar (Colombia), at a depth of 110 km, according to the USGS.
contentHtml:
A magnitude 7.4 earthquake was recorded on August 10, 2026 at 09:34 AM (Brasília time) near San José del Palmar (Colombia), according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The quake occurred at a depth of roughly 110 km.

What this magnitude means

Earthquakes above magnitude 7 are classified as major and can cause serious damage in populated areas, depending on depth and distance from urban centers.

What to expect in the coming days

After a main shock, aftershocks — smaller quakes in the same region — are expected over the following days and weeks, with frequency decreasing over time, a well-established pattern in seismology.

With data from the USGS (United States Geological Survey).
